_comment: S17 follow-up mixer probe (~10-min ShadowPC errand; rate_sysid profile mode, same as mixer_probe.json). Targets the corners the WRITEUP aggregates under-constrain: (1) TOP-RAIL x large rate demand -- c100_r31/c100_y31 measure the realized differential + slew when there is zero up-headroom (the gate-2 killer; never probed directly); (2) c60_r31 mid-band roll authority (does the yaw-only zeta effectiveness also apply to roll/pitch?); (3) zhov_r31 the roll analog of zhov_y31 (mean preservation -> eta for roll/pitch); (4) z00_y31_long 1.5 s for a clean settled tail (clean kappa_err/kappa_hold split + idle floor without re-level riding). Extraction: same per-phase aggregates as the diag WRITEUP Section 2 table (motors mean/max + a_up) PLUS the per-motor settled tail (last 0.3 s) and the realized-rate rise slope (ODOMETRY raw rate, ~80/260 rad/s^2 analog) per phase.
